# NICL.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp351.0 against Rp216.0 (expected total return 69.2%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: commodity_capex_turnaround · method card: per fund record routing for Tin, bauxite, iron sand and other metals.

- The calibration.ebitda BLOCK is answered with a statement the engine falsifies: qc_justifications says the FY2025A calibration is exact at 455.2, but cov_engine qc returns ebitda_model 308.1 vs ebitda_actual 455.2 (-32.3
- The realisation re-set from 0.001906 (FY2026E) to 0.002305 (FY2027E) - +21% on the price line - is justified by the HPM ore reference having lagged the LME metal price through the RKAB disruption, citing S3 p.317. That p
